g.title: crate Mini Postman app: latest-request action, durable history queue and curl.
crate::components::app Root: history loading/saving, the HTTP action and the shared context.
crate::components::history Sent requests; choosing one restores the whole form.
crate::components::request_form Method, URL, headers and body; send, retry, cancel and focus the URL.
crate::components::response Status line, the response (headers and body) and copying it.
crate::form Form state and the context shared by the components.
crate::http Bounded HTTP transport for the tutorial, using the system curl executable.
crate::storage Durable request history shared by independent app processes.
